definitions.policy: alpha(x) = P(product 2 | seller selected, own reputation x).
definitions.product2_market: sum_ij nu_ij [D_ij alpha_i + D_ji alpha_j]; share of all purchases.
definitions.seller_profit: Mean profit of A and B per calendar period, including unselected periods: 0.5 * [R-c1-(c2-c1)*product2_market].
definitions.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% Student-t intervals across 20 independent path means; initialization bias is excluded.
definitions.optimality: Saved selected policies are verified for each model's own decision problem on the common finite grid; this is not an MPE certificate.
